name: Simple Distillation
teachingNotes: Simple distillation separates liquids with significantly different boiling points (>40–50°C difference). Key safeguards: open system (never closed), proper condenser water counter-current flow, and stopping before boiling to dryness.

steps.prompt: Step 1: Assemble distillation rig. Mount round-bottom flask, distillation head, condenser, and receiver.
steps.hint: Ensure boiling chips are in the flask and all ground-glass joints are seated snug and greased/clamped.
steps.completionText: Glassware securely assembled with clamps on retort stand; boiling chips present.

steps.prompt: Step 2: Safety check. Inspect thermometer bulb position and verify system is OPEN to the atmosphere.
steps.hint: Thermometer bulb must sit at the side-arm outlet. The receiving adapter must be vented; NEVER heat a closed sealed system!
steps.completionText: Thermometer bulb positioned at side-arm; adapter vent confirmed open to prevent dangerous pressure build-up.

steps.prompt: Step 3: Connect condenser water hoses. Connect Water IN at the bottom and Water OUT at the top.
steps.hint: Water must enter at the lower jacket port and exit from the upper port to ensure the jacket fills completely without air bubbles.
steps.completionText: Counter-current cooling water connected and running smoothly without air pockets.

steps.prompt: Step 4: Heat gently. Turn on the hot plate to begin vaporization of the lower-boiling liquid fraction.
steps.hint: Adjust heat to achieve steady boiling. Thermometer displays an illustrative temperature plateau (~78°C).
steps.completionText: Steady vapor reflux established; vapor condenses into liquid drops dripping into the receiver flask.

steps.prompt: Step 5: Collect distillate & stop before dryness! Turn off heat when ~5 mL residue remains.
steps.hint: NEVER distill to complete dryness! Residual tars can decompose, shatter glass, or concentrate explosive peroxides.
steps.completionText: Heat turned off safely leaving non-volatile residue in the boiling flask; distillate collected in receiver.

steps.prompt: Step 6: Cool and shutdown. Allow the apparatus to cool to room temperature before turning off water.
steps.hint: Always remove heat first, let the glassware cool, and finally turn off the condenser cooling water.
steps.completionText: Apparatus safely cooled and shutdown completed. Distillate fraction isolated!

sealed_system.message: CATASTROPHIC HAZARD: Attempted to heat a closed/sealed distillation assembly! Thermal expansion will generate severe internal pressure and cause explosive glassware rupture. Always ensure the system is vented to atmosphere.

wrong_water_direction.message: Cooling defect: Connecting water in at the top causes water to run down one side leaving a large air pocket, drastically reducing condensation efficiency.

distill_to_dryness.message: Thermal hazard: Distilling to dryness causes severe overheating of the empty flask bottom, risking glass cracking and thermal ignition of concentrated peroxide residues.
